findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_real_run, aurgus, ingest_agreement, compute_close, close_agreement, true_up, edit_agreement, settle · Private data: release_notes, open_engagement, engagement_status, request_documents, open_items, receive_document, compute_commission, compute_revenue_contract, compute_lease, sign_close, export_workpapers, ingest_agreement, compose_agreement, ingest, confirm_grouping, edit_agreement, connect_integration · Public sink: request_real_run, receive_document, close_agreement, edit_agreement, settle · Destructive: begin, explain, request_real_run, aurgus, compute_revenue_contract, ingest_agreement, compute_close, confirm_grouping, close_agreement, defunct_agreement, true_up, edit_agreement_rates, list_reports, run_report, recalculate, connect_integration, settle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_real_run, aurgus, ingest_agreement, compute_close, close_agreement, true_up, edit_agreement, settle · Private data: release_notes, open_engagement, engagement_status, request_documents, open_items, receive_document, compute_commission, compute_revenue_contract, compute_lease, sign_close, export_workpapers, ingest_agreement, compose_agreement, ingest, confirm_grouping, edit_agreement, connect_integration · Public sink: request_real_run, receive_document, close_agreement, edit_agreement, settle · Destructive: begin, explain, request_real_run, aurgus, compute_revenue_contract, ingest_agreement, compute_close, confirm_grouping, close_agreement, defunct_agreement, true_up, edit_agreement_rates, list_reports, run_report, recalculate, connect_integration, settle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
